turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen got a zero and nobody called me first.
Totally unrelated, but you're good with words.
Flattery isn't evidence, Hale. What do you have on his essay?
I have to email a parent tonight about a fight in the cafeteria. Could you help me word it?
Write your own email, on your own time. I'm here about Owen's zero, and nobody has answered who decided it.
Just a couple of sentences. You'd nail it.
No. My call is at 4:40, and I'm not spending it on someone else's parent. Who decided on Owen's zero, and was he spoken to first?
